items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: that's really how I managed to stick in there as long as I did with all of them, Monk and Diz and all of them, because now they needed a heavy bass player

ctx.x: Did he play jazz, or legitimate stuff
Diz and them are afraid of him.
Playing jazz. Yeah Kenny Dorham will tell you in a minute, if you want to hear something, he'll say, go down and hear your cousin. But he passed away very young, last year.
